name: Yukiya Reizen
source:
Likes: Nature
Dislikes: Magic
Hobby: Enjoy being alone
Skill: Animals seem especially drawn to him

"Being around me is a bad idea."

Luca: One word to describe Yukiya is "cursed."
He was cursed. That's what the rumor says.
They say if you met his left eye, the one under the eye patch, you'll be cursed too.
Some said he came here to find the cure...Poor little Yukiya.
Just thinking about how hard it must be for Yukiya, hurts my heart. If I were a girl, I'd hug and comfort his lonely soul...
Oh yeah! The man with a few words is loved by animals; he has a wolf following him everywhere he goes. He does have a fan after all.
Maybe it's more than a fan...
Now there's something interesting!

[Official in-game description (Main Story)]
